title: Conversation secret fields
lead: Add explicit `[secrets]` keys for the conversation mailbox password and the Matrix token, with the rules the existing secret paths follow.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** reading any secret file (S54, S55); the adapters; the existing secret keys; the SMTP password (S67); email addresses and Matrix IDs, which are already `Person.email` and `Person.matrix_id`.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: `_SECRET_FIELDS` in `src/larder/config.py` is a closed set of three, and unknown `[secrets]` keys are errors (`_check_keys`). ADR 0025 requires a conversation mailbox separate from the receipts mailbox, and Matrix needs a token. Replies use the SMTP key from S67. Without keys, S54 and S55 either fail at load or reuse `imap_password`, which exposes both mailboxes if one leaks.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body:
Confirm the key names after the conversation interview (S61). Recommended:
- `conversation_imap_password_file`, default `secrets/conversation_imap_password`, override `LARDER_SECRETS_CONVERSATION_IMAP_PASSWORD_FILE`
- `matrix_token_file`, default `secrets/matrix_token`, override `LARDER_SECRETS_MATRIX_TOKEN_FILE`

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/larder/config.py` (`_SECRET_FIELDS`, `Secrets`, `load_settings`)
- `larder.example.toml` (the header comment's override list and the `[secrets]` table)
- `docs/specs/architecture.md` (Configuration: environment overrides; Secrets)
- `tests/test_config.py`

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
In `tests/test_config.py`, class `LoadSettingsTest`:
1. `test_conversation_secret_paths_default_under_secrets` (and update `test_loads_defaults_when_file_missing`)
2. `test_conversation_secret_paths_read_from_file_and_env_override` (relative paths resolve against the data dir; absolute ones replace it; env wins over the file)
3. `test_conversation_secret_values_not_in_repr` (extend `test_secret_values_not_in_repr`)
4. `test_unknown_secret_key_still_fails_and_lists_the_new_keys`
5. `test_unknown_larder_env_var_still_rejected`
6. `test_example_config_loads` still passes with the new keys in `larder.example.toml`

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Add two entries to `_SECRET_FIELDS`; the override names join `_ENV_OVERRIDES` automatically.
2. Add two `field(repr=False)` fields to `Secrets` and two `_secret_path` calls in `load_settings`. Loading reads no secret file.
3. Update `larder.example.toml` and the architecture doc. Fix the tests that build `Secrets(...)` with keywords.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - Config tests and the full suite pass; `repr(settings)` still prints `Secrets(<redacted>)`.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit only when the owner asks; no AI attribution.
